combo_frame: origin on the ground at the middle of the entry edge, +Z into the combo, +X across, +Y up; entries/exits are [x, y, z] in that frame, heading in degrees about +Y from +Z

combos.name: mini ramp + hump + decks
combos.what: stairs up to a deck, a mini ramp M split by a 1.2 m hump, a deck and stairs down the far side

tested.test: dropped in hands-off, over the hump and up B
tested.measured: over the hump, up B, ends u 9.3

tested.test: up the stairs onto deck A

combos.name: triple wave
combos.what: three big rollers (2 m high, 12 m long) between two QP M walls -- she flows over all three and back

entries.what: from the side, into the first flat

exits.what: out the side of the last flat

tested.test: over all three spines, hands-off

combos.name: spine between two QPs
combos.what: QP M, a vert spine M, QP M: hands off she stays on her side; a swipe up on the spine transfers

tested.test: hands-off, straight up and back
a swipe up the face takes her over

combos.name: roll-in XL to vert wall
combos.what: a roll-in XL (climb its back bank, drop in off the deck) across 12 m of flat to a QP XL vert wall with a deck

exits.what: out the side of the flat

tested.test: dropped in hands-off, up the XL wall
tested.measured: 13.6 m/s at the bottom, up the wall to 4.80 (H 4.8)

combos.name: racetrack bowl (round the island)
combos.what: a closed bowl M round an island M: carve the oval, wall on both sides, grind either coping

entries.what: drop in over the south coping

tested.test: dropped in hands-off, stays in the bowl
steered round the island, a whole lap

combos.name: bowl with a volcano
combos.what: a round bowl M with a volcano in the middle -- carve round it, or hit it as a hip

tested.test: dropped in hands-off, over the volcano, stays in
tested.measured: over the top, up to 2.40, ends 9.3 m from the middle

combos.name: bowl with a centre drum
combos.what: a round bowl L with a 1.2 m drum in the middle, coping ring all round it

tested.test: dropped in hands-off past the drum, stays in
tested.measured: up to 3.60, ends 4.5 m from the middle

tested.test: a tap beside the drum grinds its ring

combos.name: A-frame with a ridge rail
combos.what: a narrow ridge box M, banks on all four sides, a flat bar along the ridge and down rails over both ends

tested.test: up, along the ridge, down, hands-off
a tap from the bank grinds a rail

combos.name: stair sets + rails + bank + hubba
combos.what: stairs M with handrails beside a bank M up to a shared deck, a hubba set back down, a 0.6 m ledge on the street

tested.test: up the stairs, across, down the hubba set, hands-off
tested.measured: over the deck, ends u 30.2 y 0.00

tested.test: up the bank onto the deck
a tap on the landing takes a handrail down
a tap at the top of the far set takes a hubba
a tap beside the ledge grinds it

combos.name: funbox + rails between two gap lines
combos.what: a funbox M with a flat bar and down rails, flanked by two gap jumps S

tested.test: over the funbox, hands-off
the west gap cleared at 12 m/s
the east gap cleared at 12 m/s
a tap from the front bank grinds a rail

combos.name: wave wall
combos.what: a 40 m QP whose coping rises and falls 1.2 <-> 2.4 m, carved along its length

tested.test: square at w -15 (coping 2.4 m), up and back
square at w -10 (coping 1.2 m), up and back
square at w 0 (coping 1.2 m), up and back
carved along it at a slant, hands-off

combos.name: euro gap
combos.what: a bank up to a deck M, a 4 m gap, and a bank down whose back is the gap's wall -- ollie it or fall in

tested.test: an ollie off the lip clears the gap
tested.measured: landed at u 15.7 y 1.02 (the landing's top at 15.1)

tested.test: no ollie, and she is in the gap

combos.name: thread the needle
combos.what: a 360 loop with a rail M crossing straight through its middle -- loop it, or grind the rail through it

tested.test: round the loop, upside down at the top
a tap from the ground catches the rail
the rail runs straight through the loop
tested.measured: through the loop at y 3.01 (loop centre 4.00)

combos.name: corkscrew to a Y
combos.what: a bank L to a deck L, a helix rail spiralling two turns down off its edge, into a Y you steer

tested.test: up the bank onto the deck
a tap at the deck edge, two turns down, onto the Y
tested.measured: onto the Y, helix down to 1.70

combos.name: pump track
combos.what: rollers and two 180 berms in a closed loop -- lean into the berm and it turns her round

tested.test: steered round the berms, a whole lap
